title: Forecasting Earnings from Home
authors: Michael Thomas Durney; Hoyoun Kyung; Stanimir Markov; Jihwon Park
eligible_reason: COVID lockdown is a single common date: post = 1 for ayq >= 14 (2020Q2) for all analysts. Treatment is the interaction of post with var5, a continuous pre-period in-person-access score (sum of four decile ranks: distance, nearby analysts, nearby holders, local education). Every column includes time-varying firm controls. Fails staggered timing and binary-treatment rules.
design_notes: Stata (reghdfe). A.main.do line 282: reghdfe accuracy_e c.post##c.var5 $ctrlvar if ayq>5 & ayq<22, absorb(gvkey yq analys) cluster(gvkey); ctrlvar = log_mve roe btm lev_debt loss tang. Figure: i.ayq##c.var5. Table 5: same on sales forecasts, target prices, recommendations. Analyst-firm-quarter IBES panel.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Lockdown/WFH onset 2020Q2 for all units; exposure varies continuously.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common date; continuous treatment intensity; time-varying controls
specs.treatment_var: post x var5 (continuous pre-period access score)
specs.controls: log_mve roe btm lev_debt loss tang
specs.sample_condition: ayq 6-21; analysts observed pre and post

data_files_note: Analysis files built from WRDS (IBES, Compustat, CRSP, SEC 13F) shipped.
